en.bdb: The true Guru and the Sikh, association with the saints)  ,

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਬਦ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: satigur moorat paragaTee gurmukh sukh fal sabadh vichaaraa|

en.bdb: With the emergence of the true Guru, the gurmukhs got the pleasure fruit of the pondering upon the Word.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਦੂ ਹੋਇ ਸਹਸ ਫਲੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਓਅੰਕਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: eikadhoo hoi sahas fal gur sikh saadhasa(n)gat oa(n)kaaraa|

en.bdb: From that one Oankar, thousands of fruits emerged in the form of Gum, Sikh, and holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਡਿਠਾ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਸਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੈਸਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: ddiThaa suniaa ma(n)niaa sanamukh se virale saisaaraa|

en.bdb: Rare are the Gurmukhs who being face to face with the Guru have seen him, listened to him and have obeyed his commands.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੋ ਦੇ ਪਾਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਪਿਛਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਪਗ ਛਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: pahilo dhe paakhaak hoi pichhahu jag ma(n)gai pag chhaaraa|

en.bdb: First, they become the dust of the feet of the Guru and later on, the whole world desires the dust of their feet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਚਲਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh maarag chaliaa sach vanaj kar paar utaaraa|

en.bdb: Treading the path of Gurmukhs and transacting in truth, one goes across (the world ocean).

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਆਖਣਿ ਸੁਣਨਿ ਨ ਲਿਖਣਿਹਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: keemat koi na jaaniee aakhan sunan na likhanihaaraa|

en.bdb: None knows the glory of such persons nor can it be written, listened to and talked about.
In the holy congregation, only the word of the Guru, is loved.
